name: moonfinder
description: Moon sign lead magnet — precomputed ingress tables, client-side lookup, one serverless function.
comment: No `dependencies` block, deliberately: the ephemeris toolchain is build-time only (CLAUDE.md §1.5) and /api/subscribe stays framework-free. `prebuild` runs the cross-validation gate, so the `build` script Phase 4 adds cannot ship tables Astronomy Engine disagrees with (§6).
